verdict.rationale: A government filing service could plausibly offer an API with agent-scoped credentials, so this axis applies. The evidence shows no API or credential system at all: OpenAPI probes return 404, formation runs through PDF upload, fax, or mail, and the franchise-tax portal starts from a keyless entity-number prompt behind an image CAPTCHA. There is nothing that issues credentials, let alone scoped or least-privilege ones.
